adjudicated_by: enterprise-architect (Fable): independent of the author and of the reporter; standard = Gate 7 rejected-at-HIGH separation
adjudication_rationale: ACCEPT the de-escalation: a version committed without a hash row under the winner's lock can only come from a pre-table build, so a refusal would have no false positive under the contract, but the next start's verify phase records those versions as tofu and opens, so the refusal would be a one-start error a plain restart launders; making it persist means refusing all missing rows, which refuses every pre-table dev/UAT database (the note's own scope); the sequential variant is identical and inherent to TOFU; ADR-0012 already records the limit. Would change the ruling if a caller runs run() once and never re-verifies.
trigger: a build that predates the hash table applies versions (including by winning a concurrent first boot) and this build later records its own text as tofu without comparison
summary: Versions applied by a build without hash recording come back 'missing' and are recorded as this build's text on first sight. It is the documented trust-on-first-use / one-build-lineage limit (ADR-0012 'Trust on first use'); the Deployment contract excludes mixed builds. A refusal in the winner branch would be laundered by the next start's first-sight record and would not close the sequential variant. Header and upgrading.md now name the case. ADJUDICATED (see fields): the derived band stays HIGH as raised; the finding is rejected as a restatement of an accepted limit; the owner may re-open it as a design change (a persistent WARN marker).
classification_rationale: the code does what the accepted ADR documents
